We thank the students of earlier terms of this course, whose posters and reports set the bar for the projects described here and are collected on the course website. Several briefs are adapted from courses we admire: Stanford CS336 (Language Modeling from Scratch), CS329Z (Engineering AI Agents) and CS329X (Human-Centered Large Language Models), and Tang Jie's Advanced Machine Learning course at Tsinghua University. The course website borrows concepts and its template from CSC3160/MDS6002, taught by Prof. Zhizheng Wu. We thank the members of the FreedomIntelligence group whose projects appear as starting points (GameCraft-Bench, LongLLaVA, MileBench, HuatuoGPT, Soundwave, Agentic Hospital), the organisers of the benchmarks and competitions listed in Track G, and the authors of the open-source tools the briefs build on. The course's practical modules on domestic AI hardware are part of the openPangu course collaboration between CUHK-Shenzhen and Huawei (华为 openPangu 课程改革教学项目). Parts of this guide were drafted with AI assistants, including Claude Code, and edited by the teaching team; all remaining errors are ours.
